title: NodeHeartbeat
description: A provider's heartbeat: the body of `POST /nodes/heartbeat`, every HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS, with a node token (the node is the token's, not the body's). It never wakes a sleeping grid; on a sleeping or stopped grid it is the parked provider's one probe. In grid mode the master answers 404 to a heartbeat from a node that has not completed its registration (`PUT /nodes/{node_id}`), and nothing else makes a node registered: not a token, not a heartbeat, not a poll. The public CLI registers again when it is answered 404, so a node whose row was pruned, lost in a restore or left behind by a move is serving again within one heartbeat, instead of staying connected and never being given work.

ttl_seconds.description: The master's node TTL (NODE_TTL_SECONDS by default): a node silent this long is not selected.

NodeLoad.description: Live telemetry. Each key is optional, and a key the provider did not measure is left out rather than sent as zero.

unhealthy_models.description: Models whose engine is failing; the relay stops selecting them until they drop off this list.
